landing.subtitle: Launch tasks, connect skills, and watch the team work. Manage agents visually in a live AI office. SkillWharf takes care of the sandbox, billing, and access control.

tracks.title: One office, two scenarios
tracks.subtitle: The platform adapts to the business: pickup points and Dev teams get their own agents, tasks, and transparent pricing.

pvz.title: AI office for pickup points
pvz.subtitle: Intake, handover, returns, and reporting — without an in-house IT team.
pvz.pain: An owner of 1–3 pickup points spends 4–6 hours a day on routine.

agents.storekeeper: Warehouse keeper — intake and stock reconciliation

dev.title: AI office for Dev teams
dev.subtitle: Code review, incidents, tests, and documentation in one window.
dev.pain: Background agents are invisible, production deploys are stressful, context gets lost.

features.title: Infrastructure for agents, not another chat
features.subtitle: Everything you need to run autonomous agents safely and predictably.

sandbox.title: Sandbox
sandbox.description: Isolated execution for code and tools: an agent never reaches the host.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Transparent charges for skill calls, balance, and transaction history.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Install ready-made skills from the store and manage team access.

why.title: Agents work — you see what happens
why.subtitle: Not a black box, but a managed team: statuses, tools, and control points.

problem.label: Problem
problem.title: Agents work, but you cannot see what is happening
problem.description: The text chat shows the final answer but hides which tools and data the agent used.

solution.label: Solution
solution.title: The AI office is a live window into your employees' work
solution.description: Desks, statuses, and current tasks update in real time over WebSocket.

hitl.label: Human-in-the-Loop
hitl.title: An agent cannot enter Production without your key
hitl.description: Dangerous actions stop in waiting_approval and wait for confirmation in the side panel.

cta.title: Deploy your office in 15 minutes
cta.subtitle: Docker Compose, one stack, and your first AI office. No infrastructure of your own.

footer.tagline: A workspace for autonomous AI agents.
